en: A monochrome, printed illustration of a massive neoclassical building complex with multiple domed roofs and long wings arranged around courtyards. The central facade features a grand portico with tall Corinthian columns and wide steps filled with small figures, suggesting visitors entering a major civic or cultural institution. The complex occupies a full city block bordered by streets and sparse trees, with a park‑like area in the distance. No decorative borders or obvious modern elements are visible; the style suggests an early‑20th‑century architectural rendering reproduced as a postcard.
